field.label: Geolocation service
field.help: Where the map looks up the location and network of each address. Downloads go only to the chosen provider; addresses are never sent anywhere.

field.label: MaxMind license key
field.help: Leave empty to keep the stored key. Without a key here, the key of a MaxMind GeoIP alias is used when one exists.

field.label: Remove the stored key
field.help: Deletes the MaxMind key saved here when you save. A key in a MaxMind GeoIP alias is not affected.

field.label: Update every (days)
field.help: How old the database may get before a new one is downloaded.

field.label: Threat lists
field.help: Used to flag traffic on the map. With none selected: feed tables and the aliases your block rules use.

field.label: Record in the background
field.help: Keep recording threats while the map is closed, as long as the widget is on a dashboard.

field.label: AbuseIPDB API key
field.help: Optional: enables abuse reports when investigating an address, and the AbuseIPDB blacklist. Leave empty to keep the stored key.

field.label: Remove the stored key
field.help: Deletes the AbuseIPDB key when you save. Abuse reports and the blacklist stop until a new key is entered.

field.label: Maintain blocklist aliases
field.help: Keeps an FWMAP_* alias for each selected feed and for the AbuseIPDB blacklist, for use in your own rules. No rules are added.
